faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes V300d use?
faqLeft.a: The V300d uses the OM654 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine, which is the current engine shared across the V-Class and Vito ranges following the 2025 refresh.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes V300d engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my V300d?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine code before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM654 V300d engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR, and gaskets as standard on every OM654 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used V300d engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my V300d if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a V300d engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your van arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most V300d owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
